in_marathi.name: Ashwini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Horse, swift, fleet
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashwini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, the Ashwini are the celestial twin horses that draw the chariot of the god Indra. The name Ashwini means ‘horse, swift, fleet’ and represents agility, speed, and strength.
